about:
Standard Wire & Cable Co. has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since its founding in 1947. The company began as a supplier of electronic wire and cable and has grown to serve domestic and international markets.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures commercial, military, and industrial electronic and electrical wire and cable. It maintains an inventory of over 25,000 distinct wire and cable types across more than 57,000 square feet of warehouse space at multiple locations. In addition to stocked products, Standard Wire & Cable provides custom cable fabrication and custom heat‑shrink shape manufacturing, offering design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions tailored to customer requirements.

Its customer base spans military, commercial, and industrial sectors, with an export department that handles international shipments, including export documentation and packaging. The company serves clients worldwide, leveraging its large inventory for just‑in‑time delivery.

Standard Wire & Cable emphasizes quality assurance, holding ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certifications, and its export operations earned the U.S. Department of Commerce President’s “E” Award for excellence. The company states that its combination of extensive stock, custom fabrication, and certified quality management sets it apart.
